source: Picked from OpenTable's Manchester date-night and near-Palace-Theatre lists plus Wikipedia landmarks, Nov 2026

spots.name: Currier Museum of Art
spots.blurb: New Hampshire's leading art museum, with European and American masters; closed Thanksgiving Day only.
spots.blurbEs: El principal museo de arte de New Hampshire, con maestros europeos y estadounidenses; cierra solo el Día de Acción de Gracias.

spots.name: Arms Park Riverwalk
spots.blurb: Riverside walk along the Merrimack beside the old Amoskeag mill buildings.
spots.blurbEs: Paseo junto al río Merrimack, al lado de los antiguos edificios de las fábricas Amoskeag.

spots.name: Amoskeag Falls
spots.blurb: The 50-foot drop on the Merrimack that once powered the Amoskeag mills.
spots.blurbEs: La caída de 15 metros en el río Merrimack que antes movía las fábricas Amoskeag.
